question: For external networks that are marked as default (is_default = 0) and have the RBAC action set to access_as_external, list the network ID, network name, network status, the RBAC action, the target tenant, and assign row numbers within each RBAC action group ordered by network name. SELECT 
    n.id AS network_id,
    n.name AS network_name,
    n.status AS network_status,
    r.action AS rbac_action,
    r.target_tenant AS target_tenant,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.action ORDER BY n.name) AS row_number
FROM externalnetworks e
JOIN networks n ON n.id = e.network_id
JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id
WHERE e.is_default = 0
  AND r.action = 'access_as_external'

    n.name AS network_name,
    n.status AS network_status,
    r.action AS rbac_action,
    r.target_tenant AS target_tenant,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.action ORDER BY n.name) AS row_number
FROM externalnetworks e
JOIN networks n ON n.id = e.network_id
JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id
WHERE e.is_default = 0
  AND r.action = 'access_as_external'
